title: Shards: a wyrmling's three pips
note: A wyrmling's array is one valence of three pips. Chips take one pip, Elder and Venerable shards two. Brine runs Bastion Plates (an Elder Hardness splinter: +3, and +3 more while guarding with Scales) plus Razor Talons. Ash stacks Bite chips; its Deep Keel landed on a pip Crushing Molars held, destroying it.
